headline: Government and ruling party agree to expand the "residence recognition" scope for non-resident single-home owners
summary: The government and ruling Democratic Party agreed to widen the scope of residence recognition for non-resident single-home owners. Their consultation also focused on the 2026 tax reform and Seoul-area housing supply.
why: Housing and tax policy in Seoul affects property prices, supply and the tax environment that shapes the Korean real estate and banking sectors.
